powers.name: Inspiring Word
powers.summary: As a standard action, grant a creature within 30 feet a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls, skill checks, ability checks, and saving throws for rounds equal to half cleric level, minimum 1. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Leadership
powers.summary: Gain Leadership as a bonus feat and a +2 bonus to your leadership score while upholding the tenets of your deity or divine concept.

powers.name: Gentle Rest
powers.summary: As a melee touch attack, stagger a living creature for 1 round; touching an already staggered living creature puts it to sleep for 1 round. Undead are staggered for rounds equal to Wisdom modifier. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Ward Against Death
powers.summary: Emit a 30-foot aura for rounds per day equal to cleric level. Living creatures inside are immune to death effects, energy drain, and the effects of negative levels, though existing negative levels are not removed.
